title: No BPA, but recipes are Not healthy, and too much sugar.
text:
No BPA, but recipes are Not healthy, and too much sugar.. I like this is silicone , and does not have BPA etc, the size is good for the kids, and the wood spoons are great.
After I made smoothes in our vitamix, and also put in plain no sugar yogurt, what was left over, I filled these Pops up. The kids loved them.

What I really do not like about this package is, which looks to be healthy but is really Un-Healthy recipes for kids this comes with.
Allot of recipes call for cow dairy, and Soy Milk.
Try almond milk instead etc.
If soy is not fermented, its a hormone that is cheap to fatten up animals for slaughter, (I eat meat), Soy is causing our children
To be Over weight, start developing at 7 yrs old , and cause stomach cancer as kids get older. and Soy is in much of our junk snack foods.
Allot of recipes call for using baby food and infant cereals, honey & juices (100%sugar). Brown sugar, & jared cherries are full of red dyes.

On the recipes it does give the nutrition. For each pop.
For the Superpower pop, there is 12 g of sugar!! ( I rest my case).
